# NotaForge

> Simple notes vault to store, share, and organize text, images, PDFs, audio, video, and links. Built by Pratik.

NotaForge is a public note-sharing app. Anyone can view and create notes; admins can edit and delete. Files are stored via Cloudinary.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse and create public notes (text, image, PDF, file, audio, video, link).
